findings.note: Two implementations of the lint input disagree, and the new one is dead. This branch adds exported gitcontext.AddedLines (internal/gitcontext/branchfiles.go:161) while the same branch rewrites internal/reviewers/taskdone.go:350 addedLines into a path-scoped walker (addedSourceLines at :368 tracks `diff --git`/`+++` headers and drops non-lintable paths via lintable(), and addedUntrackedLines handles the `--- <path>` headed untracked excerpts separately). AddedLines has no production caller anywhere in the module (only internal/gitcontext/branchfiles_test.go:338), and it reimplements the union without any of that scoping: it concatenates BranchDiffFull/StagedDiff/WorkingTreeDiff/UntrackedExcerpts and keeps every `+` line regardless of which file the hunk belongs to. No single shard could see both halves - branchfiles.go is in shard-07 and reviewers/taskdone.go in shard-0c. As shipped it is dead weight; adopted by a future caller it would silently reintroduce the generated-path and docs-path false positives the reviewer-side rewrite exists to prevent. Corroborates and extends shard-07's finding with the other side of the seam.

findings.note: The shard wiring added on this branch is copy-pasted between two packages rather than shared. ingestShardResults is 24 lines in each of internal/taskdone/review.go:278 and internal/prready/review.go:301, differing only in the scope literal and how the target id is derived, and the Prune/GC housekeeping block (taskdone :262-271, prready :285-294) is identical down to its three-line comment. Neither existed on main, so this is new duplication, not inherited. It does follow the pre-existing parallel structure of these two files (~350 lines were already byte-identical before the branch), which is why this is low rather than a blocker - but it means every future fix to shard ingestion has to be made twice, and the two files sit in different shards (shard-15-3 and shard-0e-2) so no per-shard reviewer sees the pair. Verified there is no behavioural divergence today: prready passes analysisGit to the shadowed `git` parameter, and neither filterGeneratedGitContext nor branchOnlyGitContext touches Branch or HeadSHA, so shardTargetID and the manifest target id agree.
